result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback position: Customer has a convenience-termination right on notice, any early-termination charges are capped at three months’ recurring Charges, and prepaid post-termination Charges are refunded. No Vendor convenience-termination right is granted. The added service-continuation sentence is unnecessary to achieve the playbook result and uses the undefined term “final termination date,” so the redline is not strictly minimal and could be drafted more precisely. Otherwise, it preserves the clause’s commercial structure and is professionally drafted.
